title: Audit: stock-margin chain closes for the remaining cutoff pairs (no new kappa)
body:
## Summary

```text
native stage-2 handoff + native stage-3 audit
  + native stages 4-7 and conservative stages 2-7 cutoff pairs
= every recorded bootstrap cutoff pair lands in the previous stopped range
```

Adds only `research/stock-margin-chain/`. For the frozen selected bootstrap receipt, exact rational arithmetic gives `floor(s*L_j - L_{j-1}) > 0` at the ten remaining cutoff pairs (native 4-7, conservative 2-7), so every width `w >= e^s` with `e >= 2^{L_j}` sits in stage `j-1`'s stopped range. The two published native integers (`2851485324488315`, `1015784602045963452130`) are recomputed as positive controls; the conservative branch had no published cutoff-pair margin before this note. The stock coefficient stays unresolved, every recorded `actual_stock_coefficient` remains null, and no supplier replay, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Task `selected-stock-envelope`, priority revision 5. Scientific base `a23bdc1b07be96bea0101d44ae27d14de67a79ed`; branch rebased onto refreshed main `ec1f08b16f85937471950f986fffb2efcb4b223a` (intake-tooling only; no pinned input or selected result changed). Predecessors: the native stage-2 handoff [comment 18949652](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18949652) and Riquelme Soares's ([@hevlyo](https://github.com/hevlyo)) stage-3 audit [PR #2931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2931), which left "stages 4-7" open. Canonical thread: [discussion #2929](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2929).

## Evidence

- Before: native stages 2-3 had published cutoff-pair integers; native 4-7 and both branches' later pairs were untouched.
- After: all twelve pairs are checked against an audited table, and the receipt is bound by SHA-256 `f0bd4f22...f7917`. The smallest remaining margin is `361852943409004062662957360` (native stage 4); routing rooms `floor((1-s)*L_{j-1})` are recorded per pair.
- Controls: reusing `L_{j-1}` in place of `L_j` stays negative at every stage; applying the other branch's saving to these cutoffs does not reproduce the floors; a tampered receipt is rejected; a stored coefficient or changed cutoff fails.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/stock-margin-chain
# PASS_STOCK_MARGIN_CHAIN native_stages=2-7 conservative_stages=2-7 new_pairs=10
#   published_controls=2 min_margin=2851485324488315 coefficient=unresolved
#   headroom_guard=17 ... (single line; see README)
# PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/stock-margin-chain outcome=partial
```

Local replay passes on Linux with CPython 3.12.13 (`uv`-installed), 3.13.5 and 3.14.4; `--check-only` metadata/pin check passes on the refreshed base. Hosted CI is queued.

## Limits

The membership arithmetic does not choose a coefficient: the hoisted reading still needs a source sentence bounding routing-call width (`W_j`) by a factor whose log2 is at most `floor((1-s)*L_{j-1})` (smallest `4777557234646` native / `4777557267681` conservative). The internal `σ = 8194` reading and the `ceil(log2(8*8194)) = 17 <= H_j` comparison are inherited guards, not an envelope. The complex `m=73` supplier, hosting and precision remain open. No full cold replay, independent human review or formal-kernel result is claimed.

## Credit

The stage-2 envelope and its internal/hoisted split are [@philippeVV](https://github.com/philippeVV)'s handoff; the stage-3 cutoff pair and routing room are Riquelme Soares's ([@hevlyo](https://github.com/hevlyo)) PR #2931; the receipt and fourteen cutoffs are `research/selected-bootstrap-stock-audit` on Josie Elliston's PR1956/PR1965 work. First-stage BIT envelopes: Adam Gall, Nick Petalas. Selected BIT supplier: DreamingOfClouds's PR589 on eumemic's base, with Rohan Arun's PR1094 and Jeremy Kothe's PR1087 retaining construction credit. Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution retained.

Prepared by [@kumagi](https://github.com/kumagi) with substantial AI assistance (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the OpenCode harness), including a separate exact-arithmetic recomputation of every margin and mutation controls. No independent human review is claimed.
